主要内容: On January 6, 2014, Henry Schein, Inc. announced that it had entered into an agreement to acquire 100% ownership of five businesses operating in three European countries from Arseus NV. As part of this acquisition, the company revised its 2014 financial guidance. The press release detailing this announcement is included as Exhibit 99.1. The information provided in this report is considered 'furnished' and not 'filed' for purposes of Section 18 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934. The press release is attached as Exhibit 99.1 and is incorporated by reference into this report.
